parameters.name: DomainExtensionId
parameters.description: The ID of the additional certificate.

parameters.name: ListenerPort
parameters.description: The frontend port of the HTTPS listener that is configured for the SLB instance. Valid values: **1 to 65535**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the Server Load Balancer (SLB) instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun slb describe-domain-extensions --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --load-balancer-id lb-bp1b6c08ex0000 --listener-port 443 --domain-extension-id de-bp1rp7ta10000 --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
